lessons.title: Introduction to Git & GitHub
lessons.description: Understand what version control is, why it matters, and the difference between Git and GitHub.

lessons.title: Setting Up Git
lessons.description: Install Git on your computer, configure your identity, and create your first local repository.

lessons.title: Commits, Push and Pull
lessons.description: Learn how to save your work with commits, push code to GitHub, and pull updates from a remote repository.
